Team Offsite Plan for 12 People in Hangzhou

Context: November 12-13, budget $30,000, West Lake area.

Day 1: Strategy Workshop. Aim to establish goals and direction collaboratively.

Day 2: Hiking and Team Dinner. Promote bonding and create a sense of community.

Plan Outline:

  • Tuesday, 12:00 PM - Arrival at Hangzhou and check-in.
  • Tuesday, 1:00 PM - Strategy Workshop, led by the team leader.
  • Tuesday, 5:00 PM - Break.
  • Tuesday, 6:00 PM - Hiking and team dinner at West Lake.
  • Tuesday, 8:00 PM - Arrival at West Lake for the evening.

Budget: $30,000 ($5,000/day and $4,000/trip).

Accommodations: Airbnb will be used for overnight stays, with a maximum of 12 people to ensure comfortable sleep.

Transportation: Public transportation (buses) or ridesharing will be required.
